name: Pagans
overview: Scripture reveals that pagans are characterized by idolatry and the worship of false gods, which are described as mere idols compared to the living God who created heaven and earth (Psalms 96:5; Acts 14:15). God commands His people not to adopt the abominable practices of these nations (Deuteronomy 18:9), emphasizing the call to turn away from vain superstitions and empty worship (Acts 17:16, 22). The biblical narrative contrasts the true Creator with the futile vanities of pagan worship, urging a clear distinction between God’s commands and pagan customs.
